name: IKAROS family zinc finger 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: IKZF1 encodes DNA-binding protein Ikaros. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and protein domain specific binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to pancytopenia due to IKZF1 mutations (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
